key_insight: The paper explores whether alignment between sensory representations and motion trajectories can serve as a low-cost proxy for embodied policy success. The supplied abstract is truncated, so it does not establish the proposed metric or its measured performance.
problem_solved: Evaluating robotic foundation models through closed-loop rollouts is expensive, motivating offline ways to estimate policy capability.
method: Extend the Platonic Representation Hypothesis—which proposes convergence toward shared representations across modalities—to robot motion trajectories.
